title: Sales-to-PM translation ledger and initial feasibility pass
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem statement: Sales and Customer Success regularly submit enterprise feature asks with inconsistent granularity and missing technical context. This ticket establishes a lightweight, single-sheet 'translation ledger' for converting raw asks into a PM-ready record (one line per request) that includes immediate feasibility heuristics, cost levers, and recommended next steps.

Goal: Create a templated ledger and a 2-step operational process so that every Sales/CS enterprise ask enters the PM backlog with: a clear ask statement, account impact signal, a rough technical-risk score, a cost levers note (e.g., batching, routing, privacy boundary), and a recommended disposition (Research / Prototype / Reject / Defer / Build). The ledger should be executable by Sales/CS reps with a solutions engineer and reviewed weekly by PM SMEs.

Why this matters: Improves throughput of enterprise asks, reduces back-and-forth, surfaces trade-offs earlier (security, Dedicated vs Hosted, compliance), and produces comparable economic proxies for prioritization (expected ARR influenced by unit cost change).
acceptance_criteria: A templated ledger (Google Sheet + CSV export) exists and is linked from the CS intake playbook
There is a 1-page fill guide for Sales/SEs explaining each ledger column and quick heuristics
PM reviewers can run a weekly triage with <= 20 min per ledger row using provided heuristics

Ledger captures: ask_id, submitter, account, concise ask (one sentence), business impact estimate, technical-risk score (1-5), suggested solution archetype, primary constraints (SLA, data residency, encryption), rough cost delta guidance, recommended disposition
At least 3 pilot accounts (CS pipeline) are covered with completed ledger rows and PM decisions recorded
A follow-up ticket template is auto-created for rows flagged 'Prototype' or 'Build' including links to ledger row and required engineers/SEs
sample_ledger_entries: ASK-001 | Acme Corp | SE: Jonah Park | "Enable private model hosting for support transcripts" | Business impact: $300k ARR potential | Tech-risk: 3 | Archetype: Private/VPC deployment + KMS | Constraints: EU data residency, HSM required | Cost levers: Dedicated capacity estimate + maintenance | Disposition: Prototype (PM: +include compliance team)

ASK-002 | FinAnalytics | AE: Maria Gomez | "Low-latency credit decision scoring endpoint (10k qps)" | Business impact: $1.2M ARR potential | Tech-risk: 4 | Archetype: Dedicated with autoscale/GPU pool | Constraints: 99.99% availability, <50ms p95 | Cost levers: model quantization + routing to cheaper region | Disposition: Build (requires infra pre-commit)

ASK-003 | EduPlatform | CSM: Kevin O. | "Simpler UI to allow admins to pin model versions per workspace" | Business impact: $45k ARR potential | Tech-risk: 2 | Archetype: Console + RBAC extension | Constraints: None high | Cost levers: minor console work, no infra | Disposition: Quick Win (PM backlog)
operational_flow: 1) Sales/CS files a ledger row using the template; SE provides a technical bullet list.
2) Automated lightweight validation runs (checks fields present, data residency flags).
3) PM SME reviews weekly queue and assigns disposition within 7 business days.
4) Rows marked Prototype/Build generate a follow-up PRD stub and engineering intake ticket; Quick Wins go to backlog grooming.
5) PMs record priority band and a single-line economic proxy (expected ARR x probability x margin impact).
roles_and_stakeholders: Submitter: Sales, AE, or CSM (fills ledger row)
Solutions Engineer: provides technical context and initial feasibility note
PM SME: performs the weekly triage and assigns disposition
Engineering On-call/Owner: consulted for high-risk or infra-heavy asks
Security & Compliance: consulted if ledger flags data residency or encryption requirements
decision_rubric: Tech-risk score 1-2 + Business impact < $100k -> Quick Win or Defer
Tech-risk score 4-5 + Business impact >= $1M -> Build only if infra commitment exists
If customer is on enterprise contract with >$500k ARR at risk, escalate to Director review
deliverables: Weekly triage checklist (notion doc) and meeting cadence established
Automation: validation script that flags missing fields and sends reminders to submitters
Three pilot ledger rows with decisions and follow-up tickets
notes: Pilot targets: three mid-funnel accounts from CS playbook; coordinate with Solutions Eng leads.
We should avoid creating duplicate PRDs for similar asks — ledger needs a fuzzy-match column to detect overlaps.
Estimate assumes 1 PM SME dedicates 2 hours/week for triage for the pilot period.
